claims.text: flutter build web places the app, including its assets, into the project's build/web directory; the compiled Dart code of the release web build is the single file main.dart.js.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: deployment/web.md (Building the app for release); outputs/stage-4/scripts/frontend/web-bundle.txt

claims.text: flutter build web compiles the app's code, the Flutter framework code it calls and the code of its packages that it calls into the same main.dart.js.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: resources/faq.md (tree shaking, 'you only pay the cost'); deployment/web.md; build/web/flutter_bootstrap.js buildConfig mainJsPath

claims.text: A release web build is tree-shaken: code the app never uses is left out, so a large package costs only the parts the app calls.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: testing/build-modes.md#release ('tree shaking has been performed'); deployment/web.md; resources/faq.md

claims.text: Flutter's Material/Cupertino icons are glyphs of an icon font; release web builds tree-shake icons (tree-shake-icons on by default), writing an icon font with only the icons the app uses.
claims.source_hint: flutter_tools 3.47 build_web.dart addTreeShakeIconsFlag, build_info.dart kIconTreeShakerEnabledDefault; refs release-notes-3.10.0.md; build/web/assets/fonts/MaterialIcons-Regular.otf

claims.text: With --no-web-resources-cdn the build uses its local CanvasKit ("useLocalCanvasKit":true in flutter_bootstrap.js), so app-web serves the engine; without it the engine comes from an outside server. At stage-4 scripts/up.sh passes this flag.
claims.source_hint: flutter_tools 3.47 flutter_command.dart (web-resources-cdn, useLocalCanvasKit = !useCdn); examples/don-hang @ stage-4: scripts/up.sh:13-17, web-bundle.sh:26-34; output line 'Engine: served by app-web'

claims.text: build/web/canvaskit/ holds several engine builds; flutter_bootstrap.js picks one: canvaskit/chromium/ in a Chromium browser (Chrome, Edge), canvaskit/ in others; skwasm/webparagraph/wimp are not chosen here; .symbols files are for debugging, not downloaded when the app loads.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-4: scripts/frontend/web-bundle.sh:13-17, 36-40 (comments); build/web/flutter_bootstrap.js; refs/flutter-website: platform-integration/web/renderers.md

claims.text: The stage-4 build carries Roboto under assets/fonts/fallback/, served by app-web; only a character no bundled font has (e.g. an emoji) makes the engine download a font from an outside address, when it is needed.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: platform-integration/web/initialization.md (fontFallbackBaseUrl: 'when bundled fonts lack required glyphs'); web-bundle.sh:53-60 @ stage-4; output 'Fonts in the build'

claims.text: Before the first frame the bootstrap loads main.dart.js and one engine build, on any connection; a faster link shortens the wait but does not remove it, and a first visit has no saved copy.
claims.source_hint: build/web/flutter_bootstrap.js (loads renderer and entrypoint before running the app); refs/flutter-website: platform-integration/web/initialization.md; web-bundle.sh:37-38 comment

claims.text: Compression: the client lists acceptable content codings in Accept-Encoding, the server names the coding applied in Content-Encoding, and the client decodes to obtain the original representation.

Caddy encode with no format arguments enables zstd and gzip; it chooses from the request's Accept-Encoding and, when the client lists both with no q-factor preference, uses zstd; files on disk stay unchanged; file_server serves the files under root.
claims.source_hint: Caddy docs: caddyfile/directives/encode ('If omitted, zstd (preferred) and gzip are enabled by default'), caddyfile/directives/file_server; deploy/app-web/Caddyfile:16-21 @ stage-4

claims.text: web-bundle.sh @ stage-4: part 1 lists the 8 largest files under build/web, raw and gzip -c -9; part 2 checks useLocalCanvasKit in flutter_bootstrap.js; part 3 curls main.dart.js and both engine builds with Accept-Encoding: zstd, gzip, reads Content-Encoding and size_download.
Captured stage-4 output: six of the eight largest files are canvaskit .wasm builds and main.dart.js is seventh; the total is masked; every file in the third block is sent with zstd.

Stage-4 capture: main.dart.js raw 3,044,279, sent 929,127 zstd (under a third) vs 879,216 in the script's gzip -9 column; chromium canvaskit.wasm raw 5,428,806, sent 2,135,951 vs gzip 2,063,289; sizes change with each build.
At stage-4 scripts/up.sh builds DonHang.App/build/web and starts app-web, which serves it on :8081.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-4: scripts/up.sh (flutter build web line, 'app (web) http://localhost:8081/'); docker-compose.yml app-web

claims.text: A package can add code to main.dart.js (only the parts the app calls) and can ship files such as fonts outside it; running web-bundle.sh before and after adding one, changing nothing else, shows what it added.
